Nua Dhusara (IET 18395 - Pure line selection of Dhusra) - rice variety factsheet.
Product profile: Nua Dhusara is a long-duration, short-grained aromatic variety released in 2008, primarily cultivated in Odisha. With a maturity period of about 145 days, it has a yield potential of 3.5 tons per hectare. This variety exhibits moderate tolerance to various diseases and pests including sheath blight, BLB, leaf blast, sheath rot, stem borer, and gall midge-5. Notably, it performs well under organic nutrient management practices. Due to its exceptional quality attributes, Nua Dhusara holds promise for commercialization as a premium-quality rice.
Priority market segment: TLaS-R.
Planting method and ecosystem suitability (PTR = puddled transplanted rice, DSR = direct seeded rice): PTR: Recommended; DSR: Not Recommended; Irrigated Lowland: Not Recommended; Rainfed Lowland: Recommended; Upland: Not Recommended.

Nua Dhusara - key strengths, considerations and positioning.
Key strengths: Good aroma; Long panicle; High HRR; Excellent translucent short medium aromatic rice; Moderately resistant to sheath rot, sheath blight, and neck blast; High elongation ratio (2.05); soft GC (62 mm).
Considerations: Low yield; Tall plant; Average grain weight; Photosensitive.
Positioning (variety replaced / companion, by ecosystem): Replace - Irrigated Lowland: None; Rainfed Lowland: Kalajeera; Upland: None.

Nua Dhusara - grain yield, agronomic traits and grain shape (HRR = head rice recovery; grain shape SB = short bold, MS = medium slender, SM = short medium, LB = long bold, MB = medium bold).
Nua Dhusara -> Grain yield (kg/ha): 3000-3500; Maturity (days): 145-150; Plant height (cm): 140-145; Lodging: Tolerant; HRR %: 68; 1000-grain wt (g): 18; Grain shape: SM.

Nua Dhusara - biotic and abiotic stress reaction (disease and pest tolerance; BPH = brown plant hopper, RTV = rice tungro virus).
Nua Dhusara -> Leaf blast: Tolerant; RTV: Tolerant; Sheath blight: Tolerant; Sheath rot: Tolerant; Gall midge: Tolerant.

Nua Dhusara - producibility and recommendation.
Producibility: Nua Dhusara = 1400 Kgs./acre.
Recommendation: Released for cultivation in Odisha.
